entities.summary: "Blaze of Glory" is the debut solo single of American singer-songwriter Jon Bon Jovi. It was released in July 1990 by Mercury Records as the lead single from his first solo album, Blaze of Glory (1990). The song was written by Bon Jovi and co-produced by him with Danny Kortchmar. It reached No. 1 on the US Billboard Hot 100 and Album Rock Tracks charts in 1990, becoming his only chart-topper away from his band Bon Jovi. "Blaze of Glory" also topped the Australian, Canadian, and New Zealand singles charts and reached No. 13 on the UK Singles Chart.
